product: Finer level of detail measures in metric views are generally available
tagline: Finer level of detail (LOD) measures in metric views are now generally available.
what_it_does: Finer level of detail (LOD) measures in metric views are now generally available. A finer LOD measure uses a partition block with an include list and an outer aggregate function. It computes an aggregate at a finer grain than the query, then reaggregates the result back to the query's grain.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: Finer level of detail (LOD) measures in metric views are now generally available. A finer LOD measure uses a partition block with an include list and an outer aggregate function.
